hints.title: Identify Valid Stamp Placements
hints.text: A stamp can be placed at top-left coordinate (r, c) if and only if the rectangle of size stampHeight by stampWidth contains no occupied cells.

hints.title: 2D Prefix Sums for Rapid Region Checks
hints.text: Precompute 2D prefix sums of the occupied cells to check any subgrid occupancy sum in constant time.

hints.title: 2D Difference Array for Stamp Coverage
hints.text: For every valid stamp top-left coordinate, apply a 2D difference array update. Prefix sum the difference array to check whether every empty cell received coverage.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iteratively painting the grid cells for each valid stamp position takes O(M * N * stampHeight * stampWidth) time, causing time limits to exceed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 2D prefix sums and 2D difference arrays execute in O(M * N) time with O(M * N) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverage 2D difference arrays to mark range additions in constant time.
